slides.title: Table 1: 후학습은 5K GPU hours, 전체의 약 0.18%
slides.body: H800 대여료를 GPU·시간당 $2로 가정한 공식 학습 비용입니다.
slides.visual: 저자: “only $5.576M” · 선행 연구 · ablation 비용 제외표: Post-Training 5K / Total 2788K = 약 0.18%
slides.evidence:
“Combined with 119K GPU hours for the context length extension and 5K GPU hours for post-training, DeepSeek-V3 costs only 2.788M GPU hours for its full training. … Note that the aforementioned costs include only the official training of DeepSeek-V3, excluding the costs associated with prior research and ablation experiments on architectures, algorithms, or data.”DeepSeek-V3 §1 (p.5)

계산 5K ÷ 2788K = 0.00179 → 약 0.18%

사전학습 1T 토큰당 180K GPU hours × 14.8T ≈ 2664K

slides.title: SFT Settings: 1.5M 샘플을 2 epoch, lr 5×10⁻⁶ → 1×10⁻⁶
slides.body: 지난 주차 모델들과 같은 틀(2 epoch · 작은 lr 감소)이고, 데이터가 가장 큽니다.
slides.visual:
설정Llama 2-Chat (W02)Qwen2.5 (W04)DeepSeek-V3
데이터27,540100만+1.5M
Epoch222
LR2×10⁻⁵ · cosine7×10⁻⁶ → 7×10⁻⁷5×10⁻⁶ → 1×10⁻⁶ · cosine
Sequence 길이4,09632,768미기술
Packing프롬프트 · 답을 이어 붙임미기술packing + sample masking

파랑 칸 = 발표자 강조 · Llama 2 §3.1 (p.9) · Qwen2.5 §4.1 (p.6) · DeepSeek-V3 §5.1 (p.28–29)
slides.evidence:
“We fine-tune DeepSeek-V3-Base for two epochs using the SFT dataset, using the cosine decay learning rate scheduling that starts at 5 × 10−6 and gradually decreases to 1 × 10−6. During training, each single sequence is packed from multiple samples. However, we adopt a sample masking strategy to ensure that these examples remain isolated and mutually invisible.”DeepSeek-V3 §5.1 SFT Settings (p.29)
“We curate our instruction-tuning datasets to include 1.5M instances spanning multiple domains”DeepSeek-V3 §5.1 (p.28)

미기술 batch size · sequence 길이 · weight decay는 적지 않았습니다.

데이터 구성(Reasoning · Non-Reasoning)은 Data & Synthesis 파트 범위입니다.

slides.title: Sample masking: 한 sequence에 묶어도 샘플끼리는 서로 못 본다
slides.body: Packing은 짧은 샘플 여러 개를 한 sequence에 이어 padding 낭비를 줄이는 것입니다. 그냥 이으면 B가 A를 보게 되므로, 샘플 경계에서 attention을 끊습니다.
slides.visual:
packing만

[A1 A2 A3][B1 B2] → B1은 A1–A3도 attend

causal mask = 아래 삼각형 전체

→
packing + sample masking
A1A2A3B1B2
A1✓
A2✓✓
A3✓✓✓
B1✕✕✕✓
B2✕✕✕✓✓

✓ = 볼 수 있음 · ✕ = 막힘 (다른 샘플)

설명용 도식 · A, B = 서로 다른 SFT 샘플의 토큰 · 행 = 현재 토큰, 열 = 참조 토큰
slides.evidence:
설명용 도식은 원문 문장을 설명하려고 그린 것입니다. 원문은 그림 · 수식 없이 한 문장으로만 적었습니다.

“During training, each single sequence is packed from multiple samples. However, we adopt a sample masking strategy to ensure that these examples remain isolated and mutually invisible.”DeepSeek-V3 §5.1 SFT Settings (p.29)

미기술 position id를 샘플마다 다시 0부터 세는지, 구현(block-diagonal mask · varlen attention 등)은 적지 않았습니다.

slides.title: Base 평가 방식: 객관식은 perplexity, 풀이형은 generation, 언어모델링은 BPB
slides.body: 모든 base 모델을 사내 HAI-LLM 프레임워크에서 같은 설정으로 다시 평가합니다.
slides.visual:
방식무엇을 재나대상 예목적
Perplexity-based보기 중 모델이 가장 그럴듯하다고 본 답MMLU 계열 · HellaSwag · ARC · C-Eval · CMMLU생성 없이 선택지 비교
Generation-based직접 생성한 답을 채점GSM8K · MATH · HumanEval · BBH · DROP · TriviaQA풀이 · 코드 · 단답
Language-modeling (BPB)바이트당 비트 (낮을수록 좋음)Pile-testtokenizer가 달라도 공정 비교

DeepSeek-V3 §4.4.1 (p.24) · 파랑 칸 = 원문이 밝힌 이유 · 다른 목적 칸은 발표자 정리
slides.evidence:
“we adopt perplexity-based evaluation for datasets including HellaSwag, PIQA, WinoGrande, RACE-Middle, RACE-High, MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, MMMLU, ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, C-Eval, CMMLU, C3, and CCPM, and adopt generation-based evaluation for TriviaQA, NaturalQuestions, DROP, MATH, GSM8K, MGSM, HumanEval, MBPP, LiveCodeBench-Base, CRUXEval, BBH, AGIEval, CLUEWSC, CMRC, and CMath. In addition, we perform language-modeling-based evaluation for Pile-test and use Bits-Per-Byte (BPB) as the metric to guarantee fair comparison among models using different tokenizers.”DeepSeek-V3 §4.4.1 (p.24)

해석 perplexity · generation 칸의 목적은 원문이 밝히지 않아 발표자가 정리했습니다.

“We evaluate all these models with our internal evaluation framework, and ensure that they share the same evaluation setting.”DeepSeek-V3 §4.4.2 (p.24)

slides.title: Table 3 Code · Math: 9개 모두 1위, 차이가 가장 크다
slides.visual:
저자: Qwen2.5 72B · LLaMA-3.1 405B 대비 code · math · 다국어 우위표: 10개 모두 앞섬 · 예 MATH 61.6 vs 54.4 (+7.2) · 49.0 (+12.6)

slides.evidence:
“Compared with Qwen2.5 72B Base, the state-of-the-art Chinese open-source model, with only half of the activated parameters, DeepSeek-V3-Base also demonstrates remarkable advantages, especially on English, multilingual, code, and math benchmarks. As for Chinese benchmarks, except for CMMLU, a Chinese multi-subject multiple-choice task, DeepSeek-V3-Base also shows better performance than Qwen2.5 72B.”DeepSeek-V3 §4.4.2 (p.25–26)
“Compared with LLaMA-3.1 405B Base, the largest open-source model with 11 times the activated parameters, DeepSeek-V3-Base also exhibits much better performance on multilingual, code, and math benchmarks.”DeepSeek-V3 §4.4.2 (p.26)

계산 Code · Math · Multilingual 10개는 Qwen2.5 · LLaMA 모두 앞섬. 활성 405B ÷ 37B ≈ 10.9 → 저자 “11 times”.

“Apart from the benchmark we used for base model testing, we further evaluate instructed models on IFEval, FRAMES, LongBench v2, GPQA, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider, LiveCodeBench (questions from August 2024 to November 2024), Codeforces, Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad (CNMO 2024), and American Invitational Mathematics Examination 2024 (AIME 2024).”DeepSeek-V3 §5.3.1 (p.30)
“For the DeepSeek-V2 model series, we select the most representative variants for comparison. For closed-source models, evaluations are performed through their respective APIs.”DeepSeek-V3 §5.3.1 (p.30)

해석 목적 칸은 각 벤치마크의 일반적 용도를 발표자가 적은 것입니다.

DeepSeek-V3 §5.3.1 (p.30–31) · 파랑 칸 = 발표자 강조
slides.evidence:
“For mathematical assessments, AIME and CNMO 2024 are evaluated with a temperature of 0.7, and the results are averaged over 16 runs, while MATH-500 employs greedy decoding. We allow all models to output a maximum of 8192 tokens for each benchmark.”DeepSeek-V3 §5.3.1 (p.31)
“SWE-Bench verified is evaluated using the agentless framework (Xia et al., 2024). We use the “diff” format to evaluate the Aider-related benchmarks.”DeepSeek-V3 §5.3.1 (p.31)
“Benchmarks containing fewer than 1000 samples are tested multiple times using varying temperature settings to derive robust final results.”DeepSeek-V3 Table 6 캡션 (p.31)

Agentless: 에이전트 루프 없이 정해진 단계(위치 찾기 → 수정 → 검증)로 이슈를 푸는 방식.

미기술 설정마다 고른 이유는 적지 않았습니다.

This success can be attributed to its advanced knowledge distillation technique”DeepSeek-V3 §5.3.2 (p.32)

저자 가설 distillation이 원인이라는 근거는 §5.4.1(Data & Synthesis 파트)의 Table 9입니다.

slides.title: Table 6 Math: 경시 수학 3개 모두 1위, 2위와 10–27점 차
slides.visual:
저자: 2위 Qwen2.5 72B보다 “approximately 10%” 높다표: AIME +15.9 · MATH-500 +10.2 · CNMO +27.3
저자: C-Eval · CLUEWSC는 Qwen2.5와 비슷표: C-Eval +0.4 (86.5 − 86.1) · CLUEWSC −0.5 (90.9 − 91.4)
slides.evidence:
“Specifically, on AIME, MATH-500, and CNMO 2024, DeepSeek-V3 outperforms the second-best model, Qwen2.5 72B, by approximately 10% in absolute scores, which is a substantial margin for such challenging benchmarks. This remarkable capability highlights the effectiveness of the distillation technique from DeepSeek-R1, which has been proven highly beneficial for non-o1-like models.”DeepSeek-V3 §5.3.2 (p.32)

계산 2위와의 차: AIME 39.2 − 23.3 = 15.9 · MATH-500 90.2 − 80.0 = 10.2 · CNMO 43.2 − 15.9 = 27.3. “약 10%”는 최소값에 가깝습니다.
